event: Nala will put no price on a girl's life, but will take whatever helps her heal more.
Horne fetches a leather pouch: a finger-long silver bar. "I pay my debts. To the copper."

make.title: Leather Pouch
make.description: A small drawstring pouch of soft brown leather, big enough for a handful of coin.

changes.note: Horne gives her the silver bar in a leather pouch
Sedge Horne pays a silver bar for Tansy

memory.fact: Sedge Horne pressed on Nala a finger-long silver bar in a leather pouch for saving Tansy.
Sedge Horne pressed on Nala a finger-long silver bar in a leather pouch for saving Tansy.
Horne pays his debts to the copper, and would be shamed to give less than a silver bar.
Horne pays his debts to the copper, and would be shamed to give less than a silver bar.

event: Goody counts the rot-sick on her fingers: Col Ashby, Pim Sallow, and Garth's ewes.

memory.fact: Goody knows of three more rot-sick: Col Ashby, Pim Sallow, and Garth's two ewes.
Goody knows of three more rot-sick: Col Ashby, Pim Sallow, and Garth's two ewes.

event: Col of the watch lies at the Reeve's house by the green, his leg gone grey with a greymaw's rot.

memory.fact: Col Ashby of the watch lies at the Reeve's house with a greymaw gash gone grey with rot.
Col Ashby of the watch lies at the Reeve's house with a greymaw gash gone grey with rot.
Col Ashby's greymaw gash is in his leg; the Reeve's house where he lies is by the green.
Col Ashby's greymaw gash is in his leg; the Reeve's house where he lies is by the green.

event: Pim Sallow, the carter's widow, took an eel spine in her hand at Threllsnacht; slow grey rot.

memory.fact: Pim Sallow, a carter's widow at the Ford, has a slow grey rot in her hand from an eel spine.
Pim Sallow, a carter's widow at the Ford, has a slow grey rot in her hand from an eel spine.
Pim Sallow took the eel spine in her hand at Threllsnacht.
Pim Sallow took the eel spine in her hand at Threllsnacht.

event: Tansy's mother rises at last: Nala will eat at the mill, and sleep in the spare bed.

memory.fact: Aud Horne asked Nala to eat at the mill and sleep in its spare bed.
Aud Horne asked Nala to eat at the mill and sleep in its spare bed.

event: In the warm kitchen Nala eats bread, mutton, cheese and small beer like a wolf; Garth grins.
A young man in orange robes, out of breath: "It was you. I felt it from the shrine."

memory.fact: A young man in orange robes felt Nala's working from the shrine, like the whole river turning over.
A young man in orange robes felt Nala's working from the shrine, like the whole river turning over.
Anselm felt Nala's hour at the mill as a slow tide in the village, and goes to find its source.

event: Nala says she isn't sure what he means; he inclines his head and doesn't argue.

memory.fact: Nala told Anselm she was unsure what he meant; he inclined his head and did not argue.
Nala told Anselm she was unsure what he meant; he inclined his head and did not argue.

event: Garth holds her hand a moment and limps home to Wren: he'll have the fold ready.

memory.fact: Garth went home to Wren and will have the fold ready for Nala to see his ewes.
Garth went home to Wren and will have the fold ready for Nala to see his ewes.

event: Anselm, Keeper of Threll's shrine since autumn; his small Talent, Tidesense, feels Water drawn.

memory.fact: Anselm has kept the shrine to Threll at the Ford since last autumn.
Anselm has kept the shrine to Threll at the Ford since last autumn.
Anselm's small Talent, Tidesense, feels it when Water is drawn nearby.
Anselm's small Talent, Tidesense, feels it when Water is drawn nearby.

event: He felt a slow, steady tide from the mill this morning, an hour long, like breathing.

memory.fact: Anselm felt a slow, steady tide from the mill that morning, an hour long, like breathing.
Anselm felt a slow, steady tide from the mill that morning, an hour long, like breathing.

event: And at dawn, in the hills, something so vast he thought the Sea had come up; he didn't sleep again.

memory.fact: At dawn Anselm thought the Sea itself had come up out of the fells, and did not sleep again.
At dawn Anselm thought the Sea itself had come up out of the fells, and did not sleep again.
Anselm felt a vast drawing of Water in the hills at dawn on day one, and it frightened him.
Anselm felt a vast drawing of Water in the hills at dawn on day one, and it frightened him.

event: A stout, fussy man opens the slate-roofed house by the green: Reeve Oakes.

memory.fact: Reeve Oakes, stout and fussy, kept Col Ashby in the slate-roofed Reeve's house by the green.
Reeve Oakes, stout and fussy, kept Col Ashby in the slate-roofed Reeve's house by the green.
The Reeve's house has the village's only slate roof, beside the green.

event: A broad, stubborn-jawed man of thirty, leg bandaged knee to ankle: "I need my leg."

memory.fact: Col Ashby is broad and stubborn-jawed, thirty, his leg bandaged knee to ankle and reeking of rot.
Col Ashby is broad and stubborn-jawed, thirty, his leg bandaged knee to ankle and reeking of rot.
Col Ashby growled that he needs his leg, not a stranger, but did not send Nala away.
Col Ashby growled that he needs his leg, not a stranger, but did not send Nala away.

event: Anselm asks to watch, and offers to hold him steady; he kneels at the bed's foot.

memory.fact: Anselm will walk with Nala, asking questions, and would hold a patient steady if asked.
Anselm will walk with Nala, asking questions, and would hold a patient steady if asked.

event: Under the bandage, a long gash, grey at the edges; Col's rot is a coarse knot, easy after Tansy.

memory.fact: To Undertow, Col's rot is a coarse grey knot in his calf, easier to find than Tansy's.
To Undertow, Col's rot is a coarse grey knot in his calf, easier to find than Tansy's.

event: Between waves Nala sees Anselm rigid at Col's ankle, breathing like a man at the sea's edge.

memory.fact: Anselm held Col's ankle while Nala drew, gone rigid, breathing like a man at the edge of the sea.
Anselm held Col's ankle while Nala drew, gone rigid, breathing like a man at the edge of the sea.

event: Half an hour, and a palmful of grey salt; Goody burns it in the Reeve's hearth.

changes.note: Half an hour drawing Col's rot: a hard working

memory.fact: Col's rot took half an hour to draw and came out as a palmful of grey salt, burned in the hearth.
Col's rot took half an hour to draw and came out as a palmful of grey salt, burned in the hearth.

event: Col flexes foot and knee: "That's my leg back. The watch owes you, Nala. I owe you."

memory.fact: Drawn clean, Col's gash is a clean red line; he flexed foot and knee and called it his leg back.
Drawn clean, Col's gash is a clean red line; he flexed foot and knee and called it his leg back.
Drawn clean, Col is gruff and grateful, and swears the watch owes Nala a debt.
Drawn clean, Col is gruff and grateful, and swears the watch owes Nala a debt.

event: Reeve Oakes is already telling everyone in reach of the wonder.

memory.fact: Reeve Oakes talks to anyone who will listen of the wonder he saw at Col's bed.
Reeve Oakes talks to anyone who will listen of the wonder he saw at Col's bed.

event: Nala's well is full, but her mind is heavy with fine work; she wants sleep.

memory.fact: Fine drawing tires Nala's mind, never her Water; after Tansy and Col she wants sleep.
Fine drawing tires Nala's mind, never her Water; after Tansy and Col she wants sleep.

event: Anselm, low: no small Talent; a Keeper must write of it to Carrowmouth, weekly by the carrier.

memory.fact: Anselm judges Nala's Talent no small one, and would rather hear of it from her first.
Anselm judges Nala's Talent no small one, and would rather hear of it from her first.
He would report any great new Talent in the valley, as a Keeper must, to Carrowmouth.
He would report any great new Talent in the valley, as a Keeper must, to Carrowmouth.
He writes to his superiors in Carrowmouth each week by the carrier.
He writes to his superiors in Carrowmouth each week by the carrier.

event: "It's called Undertow." No canticle he knows names it, but he'll gladly teach the Keepers' lore.

memory.fact: No canticle Anselm knows names a Talent called Undertow.
No canticle Anselm knows names a Talent called Undertow.
Anselm knows the Keepers' teaching on Talents, Depths and Descent, and would gladly share it.
Anselm knows the Keepers' teaching on Talents, Depths and Descent, and would gladly share it.

event: Pim, sixty, alone by the carters' yard: "I've no coin, so don't ask." Her palm is swollen grey.

memory.fact: Pim Sallow, sixty and sharp-tongued, lives alone by the carters' yard at the Ford's south end.
Pim Sallow, sixty and sharp-tongued, lives alone by the carters' yard at the Ford's south end.

event: A quarter hour of in and out, her mind dragging; a thumb-sized crust of salt, burned in the grate.

changes.note: A quarter hour drawing Pim's old rot: a hard working

memory.fact: Pim's rot is small but old, a grey swelling in her palm; it takes a quarter hour to draw.
Pim's rot is small but old, a grey swelling in her palm; it takes a quarter hour to draw.

event: Pim presses a basket on her, six brown eggs and a crock of honey: "Don't you dare say no."

make.title: Basket
make.description: A woven basket with a handle, holding six eggs and a crock of honey.

changes.note: Pim Sallow gives her a basket for healing her hand

make.title: Brown Eggs
make.description: Fresh brown hen's eggs, carried in a basket.

changes.note: Pim Sallow gives her six brown eggs

make.title: Crock of Honey
make.description: A small stoneware crock of honey, stoppered.

changes.note: Pim Sallow gives her a crock of honey

memory.fact: Pim is poor and proud, and will press on a healer the eggs and honey that are all she has.
Pim is poor and proud, and will press on a healer the eggs and honey that are all she has.
Nala drew Pim's rot clean; Pim pressed on her a basket of six brown eggs and a crock of honey.
Nala drew Pim's rot clean; Pim pressed on her a basket of six brown eggs and a crock of honey.

event: Back at the mill she sleeps hard in the spare bed, dreamless, for hours.
She wakes in afternoon light, clear-headed, her well brimming.

memory.fact: A few hours' hard sleep clears the weariness of fine drawing from Nala's mind.
A few hours' hard sleep clears the weariness of fine drawing from Nala's mind.

event: Anselm walks her to the village edge: tomorrow at the shrine, he'll teach what he knows.

memory.fact: Anselm asked Nala to come to the shrine tomorrow, to be taught what he knows.
Anselm asked Nala to come to the shrine tomorrow, to be taught what he knows.

event: An hour up the river and the lane in Anni's boots; Wren shrieks and waves from the door with Burr.

memory.fact: By the evening of day one Wren is well enough to sit up at Marsh Croft's door with Burr.
By the evening of day one Wren is well enough to sit up at Marsh Croft's door with Burr.

event: At the fold rail she draws the rot from both lame ewes across the gap; they stand sound.

memory.fact: Nala drew the rot from Garth's two ewes across the fold rail at once; they stand sound again.
Nala drew the rot from Garth's two ewes across the fold rail at once; they stand sound again.

event: The sun is low over the western fells; Burr stiffens, hackles up, staring up the fell.
From the screes a long howl, and another answers, closer. "Greymaws."

memory.fact: At sundown on day one, greymaws howled from the screes above Marsh Croft, one answering closer.
At sundown on day one, greymaws howled from the screes above Marsh Croft, one answering closer.

event: Garth reaches for the old boar spear over his door: ash, a plain iron head, a crossbar.

memory.fact: Garth keeps an old boar spear over his door, and reached for it when the greymaws howled.
Garth keeps an old boar spear over his door, and reached for it when the greymaws howled.
Garth's boar spear is ash with a plain iron head and a crossbar below the blade.
Garth's boar spear is ash with a plain iron head and a crossbar below the blade.

event: Nala takes the spear; Garth bars himself in with Wren and Burr.

make.title: Boar Spear
make.description: A long, heavy ash spear with a plain iron head and a crossbar below the blade.

changes.note: Garth puts his boar spear in Nala's hands

memory.fact: Facing the greymaws, Garth gave Nala his spear and barred himself inside with Wren and Burr.
Facing the greymaws, Garth gave Nala his spear and barred himself inside with Wren and Burr.

event: She drives the flow hot, and the heavy spear feels like a broom handle. The light goes grey.
Four come down the fell, fast and silent, reeking of dead fish; the biggest hangs back above.

memory.fact: Greymaws come on fast and silent, reeking of rotten brine like a beach full of dead fish.
Greymaws come on fast and silent, reeking of rotten brine like a beach full of dead fish.
At dusk on day one four greymaws came on Marsh Croft; the she-wolf hung back on the slope.
At dusk on day one four greymaws came on Marsh Croft; the she-wolf hung back on the slope.

event: Grey scale in shaggy fur, webbed claws, a second row of teeth.

memory.fact: A greymaw is pony-sized, with grey scale in its fur, webbed claws and a second row of teeth.
A greymaw is pony-sized, with grey scale in its fur, webbed claws and a second row of teeth.

event: Her tide feels a hard bone chamber behind each breastbone, brimming with Water, and leans to it.

memory.fact: A greymaw's reservoir sits in a bone chamber behind its breastbone, and piercing it kills.
A greymaw's reservoir sits in a bone chamber behind its breastbone, and piercing it kills.
Within its reach, Undertow can draw a greymaw's Water out of the bone chamber behind its breastbone.
Within its reach, Undertow can draw a greymaw's Water out of the bone chamber behind its breastbone.

event: The first leaps for her throat; her shove throws it tumbling, and it gets up unhurt.

memory.fact: Undertow's push throws a greymaw off its feet, but it rises again unhurt.
Undertow's push throws a greymaw off its feet, but it rises again unhurt.

event: She drives the spear into the second's shoulder, and it shrugs the point off.

memory.fact: A greymaw shrugs off a spear thrust that would kill an ordinary wolf.
A greymaw shrugs off a spear thrust that would kill an ordinary wolf.

event: She grips the nearest one's chamber and pulls hard; brackish Water floods up her arm.

memory.fact: Greymaw Water drawn into Nala tastes brackish; its rot gathers on her palm as thick grey salt.
Greymaw Water drawn into Nala tastes brackish; its rot gathers on her palm as thick grey salt.

event: It staggers, folds, and is dead in ten heartbeats; the second drops; the third dies at the wall.

memory.fact: Under a hard pull a common greymaw staggers in a few heartbeats and drops dead within ten.
Under a hard pull a common greymaw staggers in a few heartbeats and drops dead within ten.
Nala drained three greymaws dead in the lane at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one.
Nala drained three greymaws dead in the lane at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one.
Undertow drawing on an Aberrant empties its reservoir, and it weakens and dies.

event: Thick grey salt crusts her palm; her well sloshes with brackish foreign Water.

memory.fact: After the greymaws, Nala's well brims with brackish foreign Water, restless under her breastbone.
After the greymaws, Nala's well brims with brackish foreign Water, restless under her breastbone.

event: Above, a she-wolf twice their size rises, one eye milk-white, scents the sea, and starts down.

memory.fact: The pack is led by a Sea-Maddened she-wolf twice the size of the rest, with a white eye.
The pack is led by a Sea-Maddened she-wolf twice the size of the rest, with a white eye.
After three greymaws fell, the she-wolf scented the air and started down toward Nala.
After three greymaws fell, the she-wolf scented the air and started down toward Nala.
The she-wolf smells Nala's well like a wind off the sea, and comes for her before the sheep.

event: Nala runs at her up the heather; at ten paces she pulls, and the chamber fights like a rope.

memory.fact: The she-wolf's reservoir is far deeper than a common greymaw's, and fights a pull like a rope.
The she-wolf's reservoir is far deeper than a common greymaw's, and fights a pull like a rope.

event: She shoves with the push in the same breath: push and pull at once, the tide near breaking.

memory.fact: Pushing one thing while pulling another at once drives Undertow to its limit; she holds it moments.
Pushing one thing while pulling another at once drives Undertow to its limit; she holds it moments.

event: She holds it; the charge slows, as if through deep water, the she-wolf's legs heavy.

memory.fact: Pushed back while drained, the she-wolf's charge slows and her legs go heavy.
Pushed back while drained, the she-wolf's charge slows and her legs go heavy.

event: Nala drops to one knee and braces the spear butt in the turf, point up in the she-wolf's path.
The point punches through scale; the chamber bursts in a cold gush of brine.

memory.fact: The she-wolf's scale turns a glancing spear, but a braced point met head-on sinks into her chest.
Pierced to the bone chamber, the she-wolf's Water bursts out as a cold gush of brine, and she dies.
Pierced to the bone chamber, the she-wolf's Water bursts out as a cold gush of brine, and she dies.

event: Falling, her jaws snap sideways and grind through Nala's left forearm; blood runs to her fingers.

changes.note: The she-wolf's dying bite tears Nala's left forearm

event: The jaws go slack; the milk-white eye dulls over the spear. Nala wrenches her arm free.

memory.fact: Nala killed the white-eyed she-wolf on a braced boar spear at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one.
Nala killed the white-eyed she-wolf on a braced boar spear at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one.

event: Push and pull stop fighting in her; she knows she can do both at once, whenever she wills.

changes.append: Pushes one thing and pulls another at the same time, at will.
changes.note: Undertow's second widening, push and pull held at once through the fight

memory.fact: Holding push and pull at once through a fight widens her Scope: Undertow can then do both at will.
Holding push and pull at once through a fight widens her Scope: Undertow can then do both at will.

event: High on the fell the rest of the pack howl, broken, fleeing up the screes until all is quiet.

memory.fact: The rest of the pack fled howling up the screes toward the tarn, and did not come back.
The rest of the pack fled howling up the screes toward the tarn, and did not come back.
With the she-wolf dead, the five greymaws left in the screes lose heart and scatter.

event: Her well churns with the she-wolf's cold brine, but it doesn't hurt her.

memory.fact: The she-wolf's cold brine churns in Nala's well, but it does not hurt her.
The she-wolf's cold brine churns in Nala's well, but it does not hurt her.

event: Her forearm throbs, torn in a ragged crescent, a thin sourness seeping into the wound.

memory.fact: The she-wolf's jaws tore Nala's left forearm in a ragged crescent; a thin sourness seeps in it.
The she-wolf's jaws tore Nala's left forearm in a ragged crescent; a thin sourness seeps in it.

event: The cottage door scrapes open: Garth stands in it with a lantern, staring.

memory.fact: When the she-wolf fell, Garth opened Marsh Croft's door with a lantern and stood staring.
When the she-wolf fell, Garth opened Marsh Croft's door with a lantern and stood staring.
